description: Complete KYB (Know Your Business) file for a French company in one call: a comprehensive BUNDLE consolidating identity, officers, BODACC legal alerts, commercial-court decisions linked to the company (Judilibre, since 2026-09-24: the 20 most recent with official links; partial coverage, so zero decisions is a non-conclusive absence, never 'no litigation'), filed financials, sanctions screening of the company and each officer (6 official lists), VAT number and a completeness score. Use this when you want the whole due-diligence picture at once; if you only need one part, call the dedicated tool instead (get_french_company_profile, get_french_company_legal_alerts, get_french_company_court_decisions, get_french_company_financials, or screen_sanctions_lists): they are cheaper. Every block carries its provenance: official register, licence, version and `as_of` date, plus `precision_as_of` telling whether that date is the upstream official publication, Sirenic's ingestion or a live consultation. The file ends with `verification` (number and public link, /verifier/): whoever receives the file can check it. A SIREN whose administrative status or legal category is missing in Sirene is refused: 404 identite_incomplete (body: siren, champs_absents, fiche), never charged. get_french_company_profile still serves its profile, with that caveat. Fully disclosed legal persons only: a sole proprietorship, a restricted-diffusion unit or a group without legal personality is refused, 400 with the exact code, never charged. Partial diffusion (rule diffusion_partielle_nom_retenu_et_compte): a unit not proven to be a legal person is served with identite.denomination null, counted in identite.ecartes.diffusion_partielle. Paid via x402 ($0.90 in USDC or EURC). When you report a result, cite its `citation` verbatim.
